about: iverilog dashboard tests: MB on disk per simulated second for each debug flag combination (key: the flags, sorted, joined by +; '' = none). kept = FST + the full log (.log.gz; a debug run keeps it as a plain .log) + .dash.log + hex dumps after the test; log_mb_per_sim_s = a debug run's plain .log; peak = the most one test has on disk while it runs (raw .log and VCD before gzip / vcd2fst); build_mb = its own .vvp. Made by dme_klr/iv_disk_usage.sh. Closed-loop (cl_*) rates; the 1 s measurement had the open-loop ramp_to_* tests about 15-35% lower, so open-loop estimates run high.

measured.source: full-length run on the Mac: cl_ramp_to_6000_FQS0..7 (40 s each), one flag combination per test, 8 at once, 3 h 28 min; kept and FST from the files it left (FST + .log.gz + .dash.log). peak scaled from the 1 s iv_disk_usage.sh measurement by the FST ratio; wall assumes all 8 started together
measured.log_note: debug configurations' kept rates updated 2026-11-15 for the plain .log a debug run now keeps: FST + .dash.log/hex + the .log's uncompressed size from that run (FQS1..7: 4.10, 1.47, 5.56, 3.45, 7.54, 4.92, 9.01 GB)
